programs.title: Treasures Decoded 2
programs.desc: A group of specialists from various fields will carefully examine: the pyramid of Cheops, statues from Easter Island, busts of Nefertiti, Blackbeard's ship, the Ark of the Covenant and the Spear of Destiny.

programs.title: Making Life on Earth: Attenborough's Greatest Adventure
programs.desc: Sir David Attenborough, a great advocate of wildlife and popularizer of science, celebrates his 100th birthday.On this occasion, BBC Earth presents the extraordinary journey of this outstanding naturalist and traveler.

programs.title: Islands: Nature's Wild Laboratories
programs.desc: The creators of the series take viewers on a journey through the unique ecosystems of islands, from the Arctic to the tropics.The trek includes Borneo, the Okavango Delta, Vancouver Islands, Baffin Island, K'gari and Sri Lanka.

programs.title: Where the Wild Men Are with Ben Fogle
programs.desc: Presenter, writer and adventurer Ben Fogle travels to different parts of the world to meet people who have decided to leave the comfort of Western civilization and start a new life.

programs.title: Life Below Zero: Canada
programs.desc: The program shows the everyday life of people in Canada and their struggles with the forces of nature.

programs.title: Surgeons: A Matter Of Life Or Death
programs.desc: More stories of life-saving operations in one of the largest hospitals in Great Britain.The series shows up close the activities and work of surgeons with extraordinary skills.
